newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EDP seeks 20 percent Telecel - paper.
newsitem.headline: EDP seeks 20 percent Telecel - paper.

text.p: State-owned electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal is seeking a 20 percent stake in Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel, Publico newspaper reported.
Publico said it had learned that talks would start soon between EDP, holding company Telepri, which comprises the Espirito Santo and Amorim groups, and U.S. group AirTouch.
The deal could be worth at least 34 billion escudos, the paper said.
EDP officials were not immediately available.
The sale on Monday of a 35.6 percent stake in Telecel- Comunicacoes Pessoais, one of the biggest flotations in Portuguese history, was heavily oversubscribed and netted 60.8 billion escudos.
The price fixed in the flotation of Telecel, one of two mobile phone operators in Portugal, was 7,950 escudos per share.
Telecel shares opened at 9,500 escudos, down 30, on Lisbon bourse on Friday.
